# Rainbow International School

> Rainbow International School is a CBSE-affiliated K-12 school in Thane, Maharashtra, India. Founded in April 2009, it serves over 3,000 students from Nursery to Class 12 on a 3.5-acre campus.

## Quick Facts

- Name: Rainbow International School
- Location: Cosmos Arcade, Brahmand Phase 4, Thane, Maharashtra 400607, India
- Founded: April 2009
- CBSE Affiliation Number: 1130661
- School Code: 30562
- Campus Size: 3.5 acres
- Students: 3,000+ currently enrolled, 1 Lac+ impacted
- Grades: Nursery to Class 12
- Streams (Class 11-12): Science, Commerce, Humanities
- Working Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM
- Phone: +91 82915 68972
- Email: info@rainbowinternationalschool.in
- Website: https://rainbowinternationalschool.in

## Academic Sections

- Pre-Primary (Nursery to UKG): Play-based learning for early childhood development
- Primary (Class 1-5): Foundation building with experiential learning
- Middle School (Class 6-8): Subject specialisation and critical thinking
- Secondary (Class 9-10): CBSE board preparation with holistic education
- Senior Secondary (Class 11-12): Science, Commerce, and Humanities streams

## Key Features

- CBSE curriculum with international pedagogy
- Multiple Intelligence Theory-based teaching
- Smart classrooms with digital learning tools
- Dedicated sports facilities and coaching
- Arts, music, and cultural programmes
- Safety and security with CCTV surveillance
- Award-winning preschool wing (Rainbow Preschool International)

## Awards and Recognition

- Times Education Icon Award — Best CBSE School, Thane
- International School Award by British Council
- NABET Accreditation for Quality Education
- FIT India School certification
- 10 Best Preschools in India — The Knowledge Review Magazine
- 15th World Education Summit — Technology in Early Childhood

## Rainbow Preschool International

Rainbow Preschool International is the early childhood wing for children aged 1.5 to 5.5 years. Programmes include Playgroup, Nursery, Jr KG, and Sr KG. 100% female staff. 6 centres across Thane.
